Please answer with the title of the review and its author.

| **Author is an authoritative Joyce expert** | Flynn is a Professor of English at UC Berkeley and a long‑time Joyce scholar, having written several monographs and articles on Joyce. |

Thus, the review “Review of *The Cambridge Centenary Ulysses: The 1922 Text with Essays and Notes*” by Catherine Flynn fulfills all the specified conditions.
